protocol.fpsMethod: Percentiles of reciprocal visible requestAnimationFrame intervals. Diagnostics once per second, never every frame.
protocol.profileMeaning: Counts are rendered entities, not physiological concentrations; each count/mode is a separate fresh context.
protocol.readinessMeaning: Entry readyMs always measures DEFAULT500 before changing the measured population. Flow protocol matches G4A; Tracking is a separate cost scenario.
protocol.diagnosticScope: Renderer counters cover Micro only; Body remains resident. One owned bump texture is distinct from renderer texture count. Visibility raycasts are not sampled during FPS measurement.

network.latencyNote: 50 ms is a CDP setting, not measured physical RTT.
